items.stem: Before enabling Microsoft 365 Copilot broadly, an admin worries Copilot could surface over-shared SharePoint files. Which Purview-aligned step most directly reduces this risk?

options.text: Apply sensitivity labels and run a SharePoint data access governance report
options.rationale: Correct: labeling and the governance report address oversharing that Copilot would otherwise ground on.
Licensing enables Copilot; it does nothing about oversharing.
Graph grounding is core to Copilot; disabling it is neither possible nor a governance control.
Removing audit logging reduces visibility and worsens governance.

items.explanation: Correct: labeling and the governance report address oversharing that Copilot would otherwise ground on.

items.stem: Which admin center is the correct place to manage mailboxes and distribution groups?

options.rationale: SharePoint admin manages sites and libraries, not mailboxes.
Correct: Exchange admin center manages mailboxes and distribution groups.
Teams admin manages teams, channels and policies.
Entra manages identity objects, not mailbox configuration.

items.explanation: Correct: Exchange admin center manages mailboxes and distribution groups.
